raw_text: 🌅✨🍃 Good morning, Oleg! For your natal chart (born May 23, 1978, 00:50, Chisinau), your exact Ascendant is Aquarius (1°32') with your Sun in Gemini and Midheaven in Scorpio (28°46'). Today, Thursday, November 26, 2026, is ruled by expansive Jupiter on the 18th lunar day of the Waning Moon, while the transiting Moon in Cancer activates your 5th house and the Sun in Sagittarius illuminates your 10th house of career. 🪐 Planetary Influences Today Today's sky brings a blend of heightened intuition and structural testing. The transiting Moon in Cancer forms a close conjunction with your natal Venus (0.63°), softening your emotional tone, while transiting Neptune in Aries forms a tight square to your natal Venus (0.0°) yet harmonizes via sextile with your Gemini Sun (0.14°) and Aquarius Ascendant (0.24°). Meanwhile, retrograde Saturn in Aries squares your natal Jupiter (0.29°), reminding you to balance bold Jupiterian ambition with disciplined realism. 💼 Work, Business & Finance With the Sun energizing your 10th house and your Midheaven in Scorpio, your focus on business, negotiations, and finance requires both strategic vision and careful verification. Retrograde Saturn's square to your natal Jupiter cautions against overpromising or rushing into unverified financial commitments. Schedule your most important calls, negotiations, and contract reviews during today's favorable planetary hours in Chisinau: 08:52–09:37 (Sun) for executive decisions, 09:37–10:22 (Venus) for diplomatic agreements, and 10:22–11:07 (Mercury) for detailed financial analysis. ❤️ Personal Relationships & Communication In personal relationships and business partnerships, the Moon's conjunction with your natal Venus fosters warmth, empathy, and a desire for genuine connection. Transiting Venus in Libra also forms a supportive sextile to your natal Saturn (0.74°), helping you build trust through reliability and clear boundaries. However, because Neptune squares your natal Venus, avoid idealizing new acquaintances or leaving terms unspoken. 🌿 Health & Vitality Your vitality is steady, though the waning 18th lunar day and Saturn's square to Jupiter can create subtle mental fatigue if you take on too much at once. Pay attention to hydration and protect your nervous system from information overload. In the evening, unwind with a calm walk, light stretching, or a warm bath to release tension. 💡 Wise Advice for Today To neutralize the Neptune-Venus square and Saturn-Jupiter tension, double-check all figures, agreements, and promises before committing, and postpone any heated debates until tomorrow. Ground yourself through practical routines and let clarity guide your generosity. ✨ Today's Blessing May this Thursday bring you calm confidence, wise discernment, and quiet breakthroughs in every endeavor. Trust your steady mind and open heart to guide you toward lasting success.
